description: Semantic deduplication — Group near-duplicate texts by meaning (not exact wording) using sentence embeddings: up to 100 items separated by | or new lines, cosine threshold= (default 0.88). Returns duplicate groups with similarity scores, the unique list (first item of each group kept) and near-miss pairs worth a manual look. For exact or fuzzy string matching use /v1/text/dedupe. Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).

items.description: e.g. How do I reset my password?|I forgot my password, how can I reset it?|What are your opening hours?

name: ai_dedupe
